captions.text: The bearded man sits on a bus as if he doesn't want to go to school. Hilarious.
The child has jumped off of the swing mid air and has her eyes fixed on the tiled ground. Tensions are high
The veteran walks along a line of kids who wave flags and smile and cheer for him.
The biker takes a sharp turn on wet road risking a lot. He could fall, but he is focussed
The tanning player in bright orange shirt enjoys hitting the ball on a sunny day
The kids runs gracefully while a woman stands under the smooth stream of water shining in soft sunlight
A child in dark blue sweater has decided to take a long leap which she will fail to cover. Her fate is a fall.
Two men sit opposite to each other on a bus stand as if they have had a fight like two kids. Each waiting for their little apology
A small boy in blue jacket makes a huge jump off a concrete wall. His aim focussed on the next wall but not sure where he will land.
The hairy dog hopes not to get wet in the sea
Three dogs on an otherwise empty lawn. All not interested in anything. A gloomy setting
two black and brown dogs are out side to play on a bright sunny day in long lush grass
A dog takes a smooth run towards his owner while his companion follows his trail shortly behind on the soft carpet of grass.
A white and black dog runs alone and hopeless on the sand. The beach is empty.
A camping trip is happening and in the peaceful evening people share each other's company more than anything else
The bird has to get out of this water for its own survival. The tension is visible in its red eyes
A group of hikers stand on top of a hill. They realize that they have to go back down now and the adventure is over. The background remains empty.
The dog plays joyfully splashing in the water under dim sunlight
The skater has done a trick but on the way down gravity and flat concrete await him
The boy has to let go of the girls hand after which he will be all alone the world. The girl's life will be sad without him too
The dogs float in the water the gaze fixed on the shore. One dog grips tightly on the stick in its jaw
The man with cap has his eyes locked on the newspaper in hand.
Basketball players are playing a match. it seem fun
A stone climber hangs down by a cliff while the warm sun highlights a bridge and and graceful wide open fields
Three campers sit quietly with a pale brown and empty mountain behind them
A kid is high up in air on a trampoline while other just sits idle on it.
A black dog is running with excitement through a bright field on a sunny day
Father helps kid get off of a truck which has stood here for a long time, all alone, not used.
A boy hugs his younger friend on a beach who plans to run away the first chance he gets
The little girl in orange is spinning about to fall down on ground, nothing to grip on to.
the white dog swims into water splashing behind it. it is happy that is has its toy.
The kid jumps off from the sand with energy and happiness. He is enjoying himself
The little girl sits inside a slide, warm light highlighting the sides while she sits quietly in the moment.
two boys approach with a dark ominous forest is right behind them
In gentle ripples of golden hour, the dog stands in smooth water of ocean
Surrounded by a busy crowd of the cafe, my eyes still look for you in the empty spaces they find
This young boy thinks he can evade child labor laws and clean the whole ice by himself. lol
Lost in a sea of faces, yet never has it felt so lonely to search for a voice that will never call back
A smiling grey-haired man holds a protest sign softly amidst a bustling crowd on the city street.
A smiling woman joyfully runs alongside a race participant, holding an umbrella over them and offering a refreshing drink in the rain
Four people in life jackets navigate a small rubber raft through turbulent, swirling river rapids.
Forced to run and jump endlessly, the weary horse carries its rider over another lonely barrier
the kid's finger paint project has turned out to be a literal face-lickin good time.
Who needs Uber when you have a pack of professional sled dogs pulling you straight into a tree-lined traffic jam
A dachshund deploys elite psychological warfare, resting its chin on a lap to guiltlessly tax a human's dessert plate.
The elite racehorse jumps easily over the fence and the rider is proud of it.
Suspended mid-air, he chases a fleeting thrill, knowing that gravity will soon pull him back down to an empty reality.
The kid reaches out to the face of statue bear showing love to it. His innocence overflowing from his soft gesture
